title: Foresight GC3 vs GCQuad — Which Launch Monitor Should You Buy in Canada?
verdict: The Foresight GC3 delivers 95% of the accuracy and metrics of the GCQuad at nearly half the price. Unless you are a professional tour fitter or require specialized 4-camera club impact location mapping, the GC3 is the smarter buy for Canadian home simulator builds under $12,000 CAD.
verdict_context: best value for serious home simulator builds in Canada

title: SkyTrak+ vs Bushnell Launch Pro — Best Home Simulator Under $7,000 CAD
verdict: If your primary goal is camera precision and room flexibility without stickers, the Bushnell Launch Pro (powered by Foresight GC3 optics) edges out in pure shot-to-shot consistency. However, the SkyTrak+ offers lower overall subscription costs and built-in hybrid radar-camera club tracking without stickers.
verdict_context: highest shot precision for dedicated home bays

comparison_table_summary.subscription_b: $699 USD/yr Gold Package for full club data

title: Costco Golf Simulator Packages vs Building Your Own in Canada
verdict: Costco packages (like the OptiShot or entry bundle) offer easy one-click ordering, but custom DIY builds using a SkyTrak+ or Foresight GC3 combined with a quality impact screen provide vastly superior accuracy, realistic spin physics, and long-term upgradeability for Canadian homes.
verdict_context: superior accuracy and long-term resale value

title: GSPro vs E6 Connect — Which Simulator Software Is Best for Canadian Golfers?
verdict: GSPro has become the gold standard for home simulation thanks to its incredible 4K graphics, active community course creator ecosystem (over 600+ courses including top Canadian tracks), realistic 4K physics, and affordable $250 USD annual pricing.
verdict_context: best course library, community features, and physics

comparison_table_summary.courses_a: 600+ community courses (including Banff Springs, St. George's)
